post.description:
Receive and evaluate a single conversation turn.

Auth: ``Authorization: Bearer <api_key>``.

The body contract is ``IngestTurnRequest``; the response is an
``IngestResponse`` whose ``status`` is ``evaluated`` (with ``result``),
``skipped`` (with ``reason``), or ``duplicate`` (with ``message_id``).

Receive and evaluate up to 100 conversation turns at once.

Auth: ``Authorization: Bearer <api_key>``. Body contract:
``IngestBatchRequest``; response: ``IngestBatchResponse``.

get.description:
Main endpoint for live monitoring dashboard.

Query params:
- project_id: str (optional) - GCP project ID to monitor. If not provided, uses default project.
- agent_id: str (optional) - Dialogflow agent ID to filter conversations. If not provided, monitors all agents.
- days_back: int (default: 30) - How many days to look back
- limit: int (default: 1000) - Max conversations to load
- use_llm: bool (default: true) - Use LLM for guardrails (batched, accurate)
- refresh: bool (default: false) - Force refresh (bypass cache)

Returns: Complete monitoring data (KPIs, time series, conversations, intent_summary)

NOTE: Results are cached for 5 minutes by default to reduce BigQuery + LLM costs.
Set refresh=true to force a new query.

Lightweight endpoint that returns only KPIs (no conversation details).
Uses cache if available.

Query params:
- project_id: str (optional) - GCP project ID to monitor
- agent_id: str (optional) - Dialogflow agent ID to filter conversations

Get detailed conversation results with pagination.
Uses cache if available.

Query params:
- project_id: str (optional) - GCP project ID to monitor

- intent: str (optional) - Filter by intent_id
- category: str (optional) - Filter by response_category
- use_llm: bool (default: true) - Use LLM for guardrails

post.description:
Upload queries for evaluation.

Accepts:
- File upload (CSV/JSON)
- JSON body with queries array

File storage depends on user_id only (not agent).
agent_id is optional — used only for loading queries into an
in-memory orchestrator session, not for file persistence.
Clear uploaded queries.

get.description: Get current uploaded queries status.

post.description:
Preflight parse of a knowledge base file without registering or mutating
server-side state. Returns ingest diagnostics and an entry preview so the
frontend can surface issues before committing the upload.

Accepts same inputs as /upload/knowledge-base (file upload or JSON body with documents array).

Upload knowledge base for hallucination detection.

Accepts:
- File upload (CSV/JSON/TXT)
- JSON body with documents array

File storage depends on user_id only (not agent).
agent_id is optional — used only for loading into the orchestrator session.

Grounded Q&A over the loaded ground-truth knowledge base.

Body:
    {"query": str, "top_k"?: int, "intent_id"?: str,
     "threshold"?: float, "min_confidence"?: float}
Returns:
    {"success": true, "result": {answer, citations, confidence, evidence,
                                 used_ids, grounded, retrieval, diagnostics}}

Evaluate a single query/response pair.

Body:
{
    "user_query": "...",
    "agent_response": "..." (optional, will fetch if not provided),
    "intent_id": "..." (optional),
    "agent_id": "..." (optional)

Return guardrail metadata for the frontend to dynamically build UI.
No auth required — this is static config data.
Returns: builtin IDs, display names, pass/fail descriptions.

Get all guardrails configuration for the current agent.
Returns both builtin and custom guardrails with their settings.

Query params:

post.description:
Add a new custom guardrail with LLM-based detection.

Body:
{
    "name": "Brand Guidelines",
    "description": "Check if response follows brand voice",
    "type": "input" | "output",
    "severity": "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical",
    "detection_prompt": "Does this violate brand guidelines? Answer yes or no."
}

get.description:
Load and get guardrails configuration for a specific agent.
This also switches the current agent context.

Query params:
- mode: "live" | "manual" (optional) — filter to only guardrails enabled for that mode.

put.description:
Update a guardrail's settings.

Body (any subset):
{
    "enabled": true/false,
    "live_enabled": true/false,
    "manual_enabled": true/false,
    "severity": "low" | "medium" | "high" | "critical",
    "tags": ["EMEA", "PCI"],
    "category": "safety" | "quality" | "compliance" | "industry" | "custom",
    "name": "..." (only for custom guardrails),
    "type": "input" | "output" (only for custom guardrails),
    "description": "..." (only for custom guardrails)
}

delete.description:
Delete a custom guardrail.
Cannot delete builtin guardrails.

post.description:
Compare two evaluations with LLM-based response analysis.

Body:
{
    "eval_id_1": "older evaluation ID",
    "eval_id_2": "newer evaluation ID",
    "agent_id": "optional agent ID"
}

Returns comparison with:
- Summary: fixed, regressed, unchanged, new, response_changed counts
- Per-row analysis including response similarity

get.description: Get current chatbot configuration.

post.description:
Configure chatbot for fetching responses.

Supports three platforms:

1. REST API (default):
{
    "agent_name": "My Bot",
    "platform": "rest_api",
    "endpoint": "https://my-api.com/chat",
    "api_key": "optional-key"
}

2. Dialogflow CX:
{
    "agent_name": "My CX Bot",
    "platform": "dialogflow_cx",
    "project_id": "my-gcp-project",
    "location": "us-central1",
    "agent_id": "abc-123-xyz",
    "language_code": "en"
}

3. Copilot Studio (Direct Line):
{
    "agent_name": "My Copilot Bot",
    "platform": "copilot_studio"
}
— bot secret is loaded from Firestore (saved via Settings → Copilot Studio)

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Sanitized error envelope. Never contains key fragments or stack traces.

IngestBatchItemResult.title: IngestBatchItemResult
IngestBatchItemResult.description: Per-conversation outcome within a batch response.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Up to 100 turns to evaluate in one call.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Monitored agent this turn belongs to. Must belong to the account the API key is issued to. May also be supplied at the top level.

response_id.title: Response Id
response_id.description: Upstream platform response id; used for turn deduplication.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Client-provided intent display name, if known.

is_handover.title: Is Handover
is_handover.description: True if this turn handed the conversation to a human agent.

handover_flag.title: Handover Flag
handover_flag.description: Alias of is_handover for platforms that use this name.

IngestMetadata.title: IngestMetadata
IngestMetadata.description: Optional per-turn metadata. Unknown keys are accepted and preserved.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Agent the turn was routed to, when known.

IngestResponse.title: IngestResponse
IngestResponse.description:
Response for ``POST /api/v1/ingest``.

``status`` is one of ``evaluated`` (with ``result``), ``skipped`` (with a
``reason``, e.g. monitoring inactive or a test session), or ``duplicate``
(with ``message_id``).

trust_score.title: Trust Score
trust_score.description: Overall trust score for the turn (0-1).

pass.title: Pass
pass.description: Whether the turn passed all enabled guardrails.

guardrails_fired.title: Guardrails Fired
guardrails_fired.description: Ids of guardrails that fired for this turn.

IngestResult.title: IngestResult
IngestResult.description: The evaluation outcome for an accepted turn.

user_query.title: User Query
user_query.description: REQUIRED. The end user's message for this turn.

agent_response.title: Agent Response
agent_response.description: REQUIRED. The chatbot's reply for this turn.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: REQUIRED. Stable identifier for the chat session. Reuse the same value for every turn of a conversation; generate a UUID once per chat if your platform does not expose one.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO-8601 turn time. Defaults to the server receipt time when omitted.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Agent this turn belongs to. Alternative to metadata.agent_id.

IngestTurnRequest.title: IngestTurnRequest
IngestTurnRequest.description: A single chatbot turn (a user message and the agent's reply) to evaluate.

ClientApiKey.description: Client API key issued from the Khai dashboard. Send as: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
